Healthy Pina Colada Smoothie
By: Nikki Brown
Published: Thursday, September 21, 2017 - 1:49pm

Ingredients




110g/4oz pineapple chunks
110g/4oz mango chunks
240ml/8.5fl oz coconut milk
2 tsp. honey (or maple syrup)
1 banana

Preparation

1 Add all the ingredients to a blender and blend until thick, creamy and delicious. 2 Enjoy!

About

This healthy and delicious alcohol-free Pina Colada is so refreshing. It makes an amazing alternative to a regular Pina Colada using just fresh fruit and coconut milk – it tastes like sunshine in a glass.
Transport yourself to a tropical paradise and give it a try!
